d: Anand Mohan News : Purnia Independent MP and Congress leader Pappu Yadav has come out in support of former MP Anand Mohan after the Supreme Court cancelled the Bihar government's remission decision granting him early release from jail in the G. Krishnaiah murder case. Reacting to the development, Pappu Yadav questioned the legal process, stating that amendments to the jail manual have taken place earlier as well and noting that Anand Mohan has already spent 14 years in prison.
